tools.description: Make your own speaker louder by one step, when someone asks you to speak up or says you are too quiet.
tools.name: volume_up

tools.description: Make your own speaker quieter, when someone asks you to keep it down or says you are too loud.
tools.name: volume_down

tools.description: Silence your own speaker until you are asked to unmute it.
tools.name: volume_mute

tools.description: Bring your own speaker back after it was muted.
tools.name: volume_unmute

tools.description: Switch your own light on, when someone asks for light and names no colour.
tools.name: light_on

tools.description: Set your own light to one of the named colours. Violet is purple; warm white is warm.
tools.name: light_colour

tools.description: Make your own light a step brighter, keeping its colour.
tools.name: light_brighter

tools.description: Make your own light a step dimmer, keeping its colour, when someone says it is too bright or harsh.
tools.name: light_dimmer
